shots.purpose: Open on a cross-sectioned chili: bright placenta, dark seeds, and not one flame anywhere
shots.claim: chili heat is a chemical illusion: capsaicin triggers pain without real heat
shots.evidence: full-bleed plate: cut-open red chili with glowing oil glands on the placenta, cool background, no fire
shots.motion_reason: slow push-in so the placenta glow reads as the subject

subject_contract.expected_subject: parchment plate of a cross-sectioned red chili with glowing placenta glands and seeds

one_second.relationship: the fruit glows where the burn is born, without fire

shots.purpose: Show the mouth raising the identical alarm for scalding coffee and for the chili
shots.claim: capsaicin and real heat trip the same nerve heat sensor
shots.evidence: diagram card: a nerve ending under the tongue firing upward toward a brain silhouette; two inputs, one alarm bell
shots.motion_reason: signal pulse travels along the nerve: information motion, not drift

subject_contract.expected_subject: parchment diagram of a nerve ending firing one alarm signal, two input arrows labeled heat and chili

shots.purpose: Reveal TRPV1: a gate that heat opens above 43C, and capsaicin opens at body temperature
shots.claim: TRPV1 opens above 43 degrees Celsius, and capsaicin opens it without heat
shots.evidence: split card: left, membrane gate pushed open by a heat arrow; right, the same gate wedged open by a capsaicin molecule with no heat
shots.motion_reason: both gates swing on the same hinge axis: the comparison is the motion
shots.transition_reason: cut to what the open gate does

subject_contract.expected_subject: parchment split diagram of a membrane channel gate opened by heat on one side and by capsaicin on the other

one_second.relationship: heat opens it; capsaicin opens it too

shots.purpose: Show ions flooding through the open channel and one word climbing the nerve: BURNING
shots.claim: the burn is a false-alarm signal; capsaicin does not burn tissue at food levels
shots.evidence: diagram card: ions pouring through the wedged-open channel, a signal dot climbing the nerve fiber toward the word BURNING
shots.motion_reason: ion stream and rising signal are the information motion

subject_contract.expected_subject: parchment diagram of ions flooding through a membrane channel with a signal rising along a nerve

one_second.relationship: open gate, ion flood, one message

shots.purpose: Show water smearing fat-loving capsaicin outward instead of removing it
shots.claim: capsaicin is fat-soluble, so water spreads it rather than washing it away
shots.evidence: transformation card: a water drop lands and oily capsaicin droplets are pushed outward into fresh territory
shots.motion_reason: outward spread over time: the transformation is the claim

subject_contract.expected_subject: parchment diagram of a water drop spreading oily capsaicin droplets outward

shots.purpose: Compare water failing against casein clusters capturing capsaicin
shots.claim: milk casein binds capsaicin and tends to wash it away better than water
shots.evidence: split card: left, droplets free and spreading; right, casein clusters gripping the same droplets and carrying them off
shots.motion_reason: capture versus spread: mirrored motion makes the comparison

subject_contract.expected_subject: parchment split diagram comparing spreading capsaicin droplets with casein clusters capturing them

shots.purpose: Payoff: a bird eats the same chili unbothered; seeds scatter where the burn never reached
shots.claim: bird TRPV1 is insensitive to capsaicin; the burn is thought to filter seed dispersers
shots.evidence: full-bleed plate: a bird swallowing a red chili whole, scattered seeds below, calm posture
shots.motion_reason: slow pull-back reveals the bird among scattered seeds: the immune eater

subject_contract.expected_subject: parchment plate of a bird swallowing a red chili with scattered seeds below

one_second.relationship: the immune eater and the scattered seeds
